tasks.title: Build and smoke-test a native menu-bar app bundle

local_evidence.swift: Swift app host compiled for arm64-apple-macosx13.0.
local_evidence.smoke: tools/test_macos_app.sh passed for the native host architecture: app bundle/plist/executable checks, bundled loopback server startup, desktop and micro GETs, and refusal to produce an unsigned DMG.
local_evidence.universal: Universal arm64+x86_64 builder and CI smoke passed on the native macOS runner. The runner installed the Intel Rust standard library, checked both Rust and Swift executable slices, and fetched desktop and micro routes from the bundled service.
local_evidence.limitation: Local AppKit launch remains unavailable in the restricted LaunchServices environment (SIGABRT). Hosted CI verifies software paths; logged-in user session, accessibility, signing/notarization, Gatekeeper, and hardware acceptance remain separate.
local_evidence.appkit_ci: Exact head 7d77c9da0a72b55ff6c5a7fcb4ad5e384702e4e1 passed all 7 jobs in https://github.com/pskeffington/pip_boy/actions/runs/41786181479. Native macOS CI passed actual desktop/micro/Stop/Quit menu actions, live-child shutdown, Retry after missing service, and universal arm64+x86_64 app bundle smoke.

tasks.ci_evidence: Final implementation head 7d77c9da0a72b55ff6c5a7fcb4ad5e384702e4e1 passed 7/7 jobs in https://github.com/pskeffington/pip_boy/actions/runs/41786181479. Earlier failed AppKit follow-ups and fixes are documented in docs/VALIDATION.md. This exact code head clears software CI only; no signing, notarization, interactive acceptance, or production artifact is claimed.
software_acceptance: macOS native workflow builds and verifies arm64+x86_64 Rust and Swift slices
Universal bundle starts and serves desktop and micro loopback routes on the runner
Hosted macOS CI invokes the actual open, Stop, and Quit menu actions and verifies child exit

tasks.evidence: No Apple signing identity or notarization profile is configured; no distributable artifact exists. The packager now builds a universal app from a fresh git archive of the exact clean source SHA and ignores prebuilt app/binary overrides; a regression check covers this invariant. These source-provenance changes await exact-head CI. The script preserves app/DMG submission JSON, Apple logs, signatures, universal slices and source/checksum evidence in unique per-attempt directories.
